title: Segment decode numerics mode (four-page states for decode rows): verification and 5-pair qualification (Qwen3-4B, A100 GPU7)
registered: 2026-10-23 KST, before the GPU test and any serving arm of this experiment
user_decision: 2026-10-23: proceed with a new batch-invariant numerics mode (decode rows with four-page segment states), re-verifying HF token agreement and concurrency invariance, pre-registered.
mode: RILEY_NATIVE_D128_DECODE_SEGMENT_MODE=1 (experiment selection by environment; a server flag follows only if adopted). Decode rows: one single-warp CTA per (4-page segment, KV head, row); each page scored and weighted exactly as by the tensor-core producer; pages folded in ascending order with an online rescale; the global-max merge folds segment states. Prompt rows unchanged.

binaries.candidate: riley-phase1-v8 (sha recorded at build) = Phase 1 source with the segment kernel, same native-extra.json, environment RILEY_NATIVE_D128_DECODE_SEGMENT_MODE=1; burst and fused modes off

gates.G1_gpu_unit_test: segment_decode_attention_gpu passes for all 8 geometries at 20 and 120 pages: identical bytes per row across batch order, separate calls and prompt neighbours (with and without the generated-row list); padding rows zero; max |segment - page mode| <= 0.03125
gates.G2_serving_invariance: candidate arms only: measured 192/192 equal to the candidate's own canonical outputs in every arm, and no mismatch among its correctness outputs across C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32 (per-mode canonical sets)
gates.G3_hf_agreement: candidate HF token matches on the 15-prompt correctness set at every concurrency >= 11 of 15 per pass (C1 >= 11/15, C>1 >= 33/45), i.e. at most one prompt per pass below the baseline native level (12/15) and the Phase 0 vLLM level (12/15)
gates.G4_primary_performance: natural C32: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= +2.0%
gates.G5_noninferiority: every cell: median-of-5 paired throughput change >= -1.3%, TPOT p50 change <= +1.5%, TPOT p99 change <= +10%

cells: fixed C1/C8/C16/C32 and natural C8/C32, 5 fresh pairs each, 64 warm + 192 measured, runner order alternation
reporting: All pairs and metrics; measured-workload HF matches; share of measured outputs equal to the per-page mode's outputs (informational); nothing excluded or repeated; an aborted arm is preserved and continued under a new label
decision: All gates pass -> adopt as the recommended Qwen3-4B native attention mode and add an explicit server flag; any gate fails -> keep the per-page mode and record why
